info.title: Workday Universal API
info.description: Workday scaffold based on the attached Time Tracking v5 OpenAPI spec. Current scope covers worker retrieval plus worker time block retrieval and create/update shells for timesheet-style entries.

post.description: Create a worker time block in Workday Time Tracking for a specific worker using either quantity-based or clock-in and clock-out entry fields.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

workerId.description: The Workday ID of the worker for whom the time block will be created.

calendarDate.description: Required for hourly entry together with Reported Quantity.

reportedQuantity.description: Required for hourly entry together with Calendar Date.

inTime.description: Required for in/out entry together with Out Time, In Time Zone ID, and Out Time Zone ID.

outTime.description: Required for in/out entry together with In Time, In Time Zone ID, and Out Time Zone ID.

inTimeZone.description: Reference object for the in time zone.

inTimeZone.id.description: The Workday ID for the selected in time zone reference.

outTimeZone.description: Reference object for the out time zone.

outTimeZone.id.description: The Workday ID for the selected out time zone reference.

timeEntryCode.description: Reference object for the selected time entry code.

timeEntryCode.id.description: The Workday ID for the selected time entry code reference.

project.description: Reference object for the selected project.

project.id.description: The Workday ID for the selected project reference.

projectPlanTask.description: Reference object for the selected project plan task.

projectPlanTask.id.description: The Workday ID for the selected project plan task reference.

get.description: List worker time blocks from Workday Time Tracking so you can review timesheet-style entries by worker, date range, status, project, or task.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: worker
parameters.description: The Workday ID of the worker for the time block filter.

schema.description: The Workday ID of the worker for the time block filter.

parameters.name: fromDate
parameters.description: Start date of the time block date range filter.

schema.description: Start date of the time block date range filter.

parameters.name: toDate
parameters.description: End date of the time block date range filter.

schema.description: End date of the time block date range filter.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: The Workday ID of the approval status for the time block filter.

schema.description: The Workday ID of the approval status for the time block filter.

parameters.name: phase
parameters.description: The Workday ID of the project plan phase filter.

parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

calendarDate.description: The calendar date for the time block.

comment.description: Comment on the time block when present.

descriptor.description: The display name of the worker time block.

id.description: The ID for the worker time block.

inTime.description: Clock-in time for in/out time blocks.

inTimeZone.description: Time zone information for the in time.

outTime.description: Clock-out time for in/out time blocks.

outTimeZone.description: Time zone information for the out time.

project.description: Project details when the time block is project-based.

projectPlanTask.description: Project plan task details when applicable.

reportedQuantity.description: Reported quantity for quantity-based time blocks.

status.description: Approval status details for the time block.

timeEntryCode.description: Time entry code details when applicable.

worker.description: Worker details for the time block.
